subject: Re: API migration plan
body_preview: Looks good to me. One question about the backwards compatibility layer...
body:
Looks good to me. One question about the backwards compatibility layer — are we planning to keep the v1 endpoints running for 30 days or 90 days?

The client SDK migration guide should probably mention both timelines so teams can plan accordingly.

Also, can we add a deprecation header to the v1 responses? That way monitoring will catch any stragglers.

subject: Security advisory: CVE-2026-1234
body_preview: A medium-severity vulnerability has been identified in our authentication library...
body:
A medium-severity vulnerability has been identified in our authentication library (auth-core v3.2.1).

Impact: Session token leakage under specific proxy configurations.
Severity: Medium (CVSS 5.3)
Affected versions: auth-core 3.0.0 - 3.2.1
Fixed in: auth-core 3.2.2

Action required: Update auth-core to >= 3.2.2 by April 15.

If you have questions, reach out in #security-incidents.
